reviews.title: Impossible to navigate
reviews.text: JL used to be so easy to use. Now apparently “new and improved” with so many bells and whistles it’s a chore to navigate. Took me 20 minutes to send a simple birthday card and even then I could not select a delivery TIME. never again!

reviews.title: Much difficulty with the process very unintuitive
reviews.text: The process of writing a message prior to previewing the card is backwards.

reviews.title: Confusion reigns
reviews.text:
This website is still not able to be used….it keeps sending  one back to verify password even though it was already done …..then tells u it is incorrect….and what you have already chosen and filled out is lost…..you need a webmaster who’s intelligent…..I had cancelled my membership because of this and issues about gifts  
To be included…..angry!!!!

reviews.title: Awkward at best!
reviews.text: The "mechanics" of this site reflect  solid 70's technology. Absolutely not user friendly.

reviews.title: All kinds of trouble
reviews.text: Just got your site loaded onto new iPad and after being a user for years I am truly frustrated by this new version. I cannot find where cards pending or any of that kind of information is.

reviews.title: Stop the voice descriptions on the cards. My friends are not blind!stop
reviews.text: Stop the unnecessary descriptions about the cards. Help!

reviews.title: Birthday card
reviews.text: It’s a shame I no longer can just get a link and attach it to their Facebook page…. If I don’t have their email address or text number I can’t send anything.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: Your site used to be so easy to use with lovely cards with music.  I had great difficulty getting into your site there was nowhere to sign in and it took me ages - what has happened?

reviews.title: Weak Website
reviews.text:
Hard to find address book, constantly have
to reset password 
Cards aren’t up to the standard that they used to be.
There are better electronic card services 
Don’t use this one!!!

reviews.title: Troubled
reviews.text: Not value for money to many problems

reviews.title: No search function on app?
reviews.text:
Been using the website for years to send cards and thought I’d try the app. 

I know exactly  which cards I want to send to people, but on the app I can’t find the search function. Why am I having to  wade through categories when I know the name of the card?

reviews.title: Customer service non existent
reviews.text:
I made an error in set up by hiding my email address and realised this was a mistake and since the 24th December & numerous attempts at contacting them via different methods as advised on their 
help page I still have received no response at all.
